correctness.rationale: Exact logarithmic normalization gives Y=A-x^2 p/(4t)+xq/2-q^2t/(4p), p=1/D>0, q=v/D>0. Two differences yield q=ap+b and gamma=kappa p-2ab-b^2/p. For positive kappa the derivative kappa+b^2/p^2>0 guarantees uniqueness; for negative kappa choose b>0 and two arbitrary distinct positive p with p1*p2=-b^2/kappa, yielding two positive q. At zero kappa, b=0 gives infinitely many p>0. No more than two solutions for negative kappa since the inverse equation is quadratic. The fourth rectangle corner linearly recovers p and q, then A. The explicit pair matches exact rational normalized logs at the first three points but not the fourth. All boundaries, physical positivity, and converse existence checked.

originality.rationale: The exact inverse design parameter set (unknown M,D,v, known impulse location and time), sparse two-station L-shaped sampling, iff global injectivity boundary and ambiguity multiplicity were compared by mathematical implication to the material of relevant prior work. Closest full 2005 source recovers unknown source location/time history with *known* transport parameters and continuous monitoring; 2020 source-parameter study likewise treats flow speed and diffusivity as known system coefficients. Neither logically specializes to a sharp three-sample design for unknown transport parameters. General algebraic inverse literature might still imply it.
residual_risks: A general identifiability or Gaussian parameter interpolation theorem may already imply the sharp sparse three-reading phase boundary; semantic searches cannot rule out all equivalences.
The full 2013 spatially varying inverse-source paper and the full Han et al. 2014 article were not read; no statement of NOT_COVERING their entire text is made.
This result is exact structural identifiability, not inference under stochastic measurement noise or proof of numerical stability near the critical geometric boundary.

value.rationale: The exact global injectivity boundary is a motivated complete classification of a natural constrained two-station intermittent water-tracer sampling design, where local positive Jacobian rank can conceal two distinct admissible parameter triples. It couples station spacing and time separation, proves the critical infinite-fiber case, and establishes an exact single-measurement repair. The geometry is nontrivial across the full positive parameter domain; no general downstream theorem or field reliability guarantee is claimed.
